**Finding: missing (insurance clause absent) — redline validated and submitted.**

- The agreement has no insurance provision at all; the sole "insurance" hit is incidental (Net Revenue definition, p0012).
- Commerce One is the vendor side here: under §13 (Shared Resources) its operations, consulting and engineering personnel — and possibly a third-party systems integrator (p0112) — work on the hosted Software environment and may access Corio and Customer data, so the rule applies.
- Inserted a new §14.10 Insurance in Miscellaneous at the preferred position (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where our data is processed, workers' comp as required by law, certificates on request), and renumbered Complete Understanding to 14.11 to keep the signature block last. Fallback (E&O 1M / cyber 2M) is flagged in the comment.
